title_en: EQUILIBRIUM — A FIELD GUIDE TO LAGRANGE POINTS
title_ru: РАВНОВЕСИЕ — ПОЛЕВОЙ СПРАВОЧНИК ПО ТОЧКАМ ЛАГРАНЖА
description: Lagrange points done properly: an exact L1–L3 solver, zero-velocity curves, the L4/L5 stability limit, halo orbits, Trojans and the missions that use them.
og: Solve L1, L2 and L3 exactly, open the gates of the effective potential, find where L4 and L5 stop being stable and what it costs to stay: Lagrange points, interactive and sourced.
brand: EQUILIBRIUM — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
llms: Lagrange points from the circular restricted three-body problem: rotating frame, effective potential and zero-velocity curves; an exact solver for L1–L3 (the quintic) beside the Hill-radius formula and its error for Sun–Earth, Sun–Jupiter, Earth–Moon and Pluto–Charon; L4/L5 and the stability limit μ < 0.03852 (mass ratio > 24.96); Euler's collinear and Lagrange's triangular points credited separately; halo and Lissajous orbits and published station-keeping costs; Trojan asteroids; a dated register of missions at Sun–Earth L1/L2 and the Earth–Moon points.
